policy.thisWebsiteStoresYourLightOrDarkT: This website stores your light or dark theme preference in local browser storage. It does not actively integrate third-party analytics scripts or advertising trackers. Hosting servers may still process IP addresses, timestamps, and browser information needed to serve requests.
policy.registrationAndSignInAreHandledBy: Registration and sign-in are handled by the ClawMuse account service, including email, profile details, password authentication information, and sessions. Device enrollment stores device identifiers, names, and encrypted connection information so the same account can discover and connect devices.
policy.projectFilesAgentsAndTerminalsLiv: Project files, agents, and terminals live on the machine you choose. Remote access carries workspace content through encrypted traffic. Your AI tools may send code, prompts, or other content to model services according to their configuration and those providers' policies.
policy.mobileSessionsUseSystemSecureStor: Mobile sessions use system secure storage; the desktop uses system-provided encrypted storage. Linux enrollment uses a temporary session and attempts to revoke it on completion, without persisting the account password. Device connection keys remain on the execution host.
policy.youCanSignOutRemoveDeviceDirector: In the current app, open your ClawMuse account settings and choose Delete account, then confirm with your password. This permanently deletes your personal cloud account. Signing out or removing a device entry does not delete the account or revoke separately paired host access. Manage those credentials on each host before deletion.
policy.serviceAvailability: ClawMuse provides software for connecting to your own agents and workspaces. The source code is public on GitHub under the Apache-2.0 license; optional add-on services are billed separately. See the download page for supported platforms.
policy.protectYourCredentialsAndLinkOnly: Protect your credentials and link only machines you own or are authorized to use. You are responsible for project permissions, tool authorization, and actions on connected machines. Do not share pairing links or device keys.
policy.clawmuseConnectsYourDevelopmentEn: ClawMuse connects your development environment and does not include a model subscription. Third-party AI tools have their own terms. Review generated content and execution results, and keep backups or version history before important operations.
policy.followApplicableRulesAndThirdPart: Follow applicable rules and third-party service requirements. Do not use connections to access others' systems without authorization, obtain others' information, or disrupt services. Keep tasks within the permissions granted on the host.
policy.youCanSignOutAndStopTheClientOr: You can sign out and stop the client or daemon. Remote tasks do not automatically stop when you sign out on the phone; manage them separately in the workspace or on the host. Send feedback to hello@clawmuse.com.
policy.thisPageDescribesTheCurrentProduc: This page describes the current product's use and data handling. It will be updated as the service changes.

faq.1.question: Does Linux need the desktop app?
faq.1.answer: No. Start the ClawMuse background service on Linux and link your account to connect from your phone. Follow the Linux guide for setup.
faq.3.question: Does signing out stop remote tasks?
faq.3.answer: No. Tasks continue while your computer and agent are running. Use the stop action in the conversation to end a task.
faq.4.question: How is this different from the official Claude and Codex mobile and web apps?
faq.4.answer: Official apps only work with their own tools and models, and their web versions usually run tasks in the vendor’s cloud. ClawMuse connects your phone and browser to your own computer, where your projects and environment live. Choose Claude Code, Codex or other tools and models, all in one place.

accountData.title: Account and data
accountData.intro: Manage your connections and understand what an account or data removal request covers. Signing out does not stop tasks on your computer.
accountData.privateRequest: You can request deletion without installing the app: email hello@clawmuse.com with the subject “ClawMuse account deletion” from your registered email address. Identify the account and any additional services concerned. We verify ownership and confirm completion, or explain any data that must be retained and why. Never send passwords or tokens. In the current app, you can also delete your account directly from ClawMuse account settings.

brand.ideaBody: Your agent is working, but you need to head out. With ClawMuse, you can check progress and answer questions from your phone, then return to the same project.
brand.actionBody: Claw represents action: agents use the tools on your machine to move an idea forward. You can inspect the result, add direction and choose what happens next.
brand.personalBody: ClawMuse connects your computer’s AI tools so you can send tasks, check progress and review changes from your phone or the web.
policy.retentionBody: Account details and device directory entries remain while your account is active. Deleting your account removes its credentials, sessions, directory entries and personally linked Status and Goals data from active service storage. Local projects, separately paired host credentials, shared organization records and data held by your model or speech providers are not deleted by this action. Backups and records retained for legal or security obligations may remain subject to their applicable retention schedules; contact us for the scope and retention that apply to your request. A hashed account identifier is retained to reject stale credentials after deletion.
policy.rightsBody: Contact hello@clawmuse.com to request access, correction, export or deletion of your personal data, or to ask about processing and retention. We verify account ownership before releasing or deleting data. You can sign out, stop using AI and voice features, or stop tasks on the computer running them. Data already sent to a provider cannot be recalled. Depending on your location, you may also complain to your data protection authority.
policy.contactBody: ClawMuse Studio is the development and operating brand for ClawMuse. For questions about your personal data or this policy, contact hello@clawmuse.com. This policy covers the ClawMuse app, website and official account, relay, Status and Goals services; independently operated hosts and third-party providers have their own policies.
